'''Jasper McKnives''' was a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] swordsman from [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he was a mentally unstable fanatic who served with devotion to the [[Cult of M'dweshuu]], a deadly blood cult that had long terrorized the people of his homeworld. For his crimes, Jasper was thrown into the [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] pits as punishment, but it was exactly what he wanted. Nonetheless, he was soon cut down by the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-wielding warrior [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].

==Biography==
Jasper McKnives hailed from the planet [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]],<ref name="DB" /> located in the [[Si'Klaata Cluster/Legends|Si'Klaata Cluster]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> In the distant past, much of his homeworld was controlled by the powerful [[Cult of M'dweshuu]] until it was put down by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].<ref name="CEI">{{CSWECite|I|156|Cult of M'dweshuu}}</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="CE" /> the mentally unstable Jasper McKnives became part of this ancient and deadly cult. Soon, a string of brutal cult slayings brought him to the attention of the war barons and organizers of the [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattataki]] gladiatorial games. It is not known how, but Jasper was eventually thrown into the [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] pits of Rattatak as punishment for his murders,<ref name="DB" /> forcing McKnives to fight his way to freedom.<ref name="CE" /> However, this was exactly what he wanted, and Jasper fought only out of his fanatical devotion to the Cult of M'dweshuu.<ref name="DB" />

Eventually, Jasper McKnives ended up in the [[the Cauldron]] arena<ref name="CW" /> and, notably, he had no patron, which made him the only gladiator who had entered himself into the contests.<ref name="DB" /> The Cauldron was the largest gladiatorial pit on Rattatak, filled with violent warriors, where war barons and generals sought out the best combatants who would win their wars.<ref name="DBR">{{DB|location|rattatak|Rattatak}}</ref> Therefore, a Kintan fanatic, like many other gladiators,<ref name="CW" /> entered a deadly free-for-all battle,<ref name="EGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> but it was a rare gladiator indeed who could survive multiple fights there.<ref name="DBR" />

[[File:GladiatorsOnTheCauldron2.jpg|280px|left|thumb|Jasper McKnives and the other gladiators preparing to attack Asajj Ventress]]
During one battle, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] attended the match in the Cauldron, hoping to find a new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] among the fighters.<ref name="CW" /> At the same time, Jasper McKnives was in the arena, where he faced off against several opponents, including the combat droid [[L8-L9]].<ref name="EGD" /> Soon, the [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] entered the arena and, in a short time, defeated most of the remaining gladiators. The survivors united for a single attack against Ventress, but she used the [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to crush stone debris from the ceiling onto their heads. Jasper McKnives was among the first to be caught in the rockfall,<ref name="CW" /> which killed him.<ref name="CE" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:JasperFace.jpg|230px|right|thumb|The snarl of Jasper]]
This [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] swordsman<ref name="EGD" /> was a fanatic member<ref name="CE" /> of a [[Cult of M'dweshuu|deadly blood cult]] that had long terrorized the people of his [[Kintan/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="DB" /> Jasper's legacy was not defined by his physical abilities, but rather by his mental instability. His bloody record of brutal cult slayings<ref name="CE" /> brought him to the attention of the war barons and organizers of the [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] games. As punishment for his murders,<ref name="DB" /> Jasper was placed in the gladiator pits, forcing him to fight for his life,<ref name="CE" /> but it was exactly what he wanted. Of all the [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattataki]] combatants, Jasper McKnives had no patron and was the only gladiator who entered himself into the contests. He fought not for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] or for freedom, but solely out of his fanatical devotion to the cult. In battle, he preferred assorted [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]] and [[Knife/Legends|knives]].<ref name="DB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jasper McKnives<ref name="DB" /> first appeared as an unnamed background character in the [[Chapter 6 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|sixth chapter]]<ref name="CW" /> of ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'', an animated television micro-series<ref name="Chapter Archive">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/microseries/chapter/archive.html|text=View ''Clone Wars'' Chapter Archive}}</ref> produced by [[Cartoon Network]] Studios<ref name="Volume One">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Volume One|''Star Wars: Clone Wars'' Volume One]]</ref> and originally aired on [[November 14]], [[2003]].<ref name="TV">{{TVcom|url=shows/star-wars-clone-wars/chapter-vi-276612|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars - Season 1, Episode 6: Chapter VI}}</ref> The character was later given a name and short backstory in the personal [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry on the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' website, [[StarWars.com]], in [[2003]].<ref name="BS">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20031119.html|text=The Blood-sport of Rattatak}}</ref> Jasper McKnives later appeared in ''[[Ultimate Sticker Book: Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'', a sticker book written by [[Simon Beecroft]] and released in [[2004]],<ref name="DK">{{DK|url=us/9780756607593-ultimate-sticker-book-star-wars-clone-wars|text=Ultimate Sticker Book: Star Wars: Clone Wars|nolive=1}}</ref> where he was named Kullta Kutta.<ref name="Sticker">''[[Ultimate Sticker Book: Star Wars: Clone Wars]]''</ref>
